name: Carson custom pair sell-side reserve burn
summary: The closed-source Carson/USDT pair, after each swap's k check, moved a factory-configured share of the input token out of its own reserve (30% to 0xdead, 30% to a fee wallet for Carson sells) and synced. The attacker bought Carson with flash-loaned USDT and sold it back in 51 chunks, each shrinking the Carson reserve, draining the pair's USDT.
notes: Factory owner call 0x3a2980ea(pair, Carson, 0x376bceeae444eebf5e77490eb6d06fe35f2f5305, 0.3e18, 0xdead, 0.3e18) set the pair's Carson-input reserve-removal shares from none to 30% + 30%. The pair reads them via factory 0x918b6c8d(pair, token) on every swap; with zero shares the post-check removal does not occur.

Loss is the pair's net USDT debit over the attacker's four calls (flash-loaned USDT swapped in netted out). The pair's Carson outflow is not valued: the drained pair was that token's market. Only these four txs ever made more than one swap on the pair.
Pair, factory and token are closed source; the reserve-removal behaviour is established from execution traces, receipts and factory view calls rather than verified source.
